provisionalTranslation: The Arabic source texts on this screen are provisional translations of the English playbook text.

entry.body: Choose a transformation to open this screen for it.
entry.chooseLaunch: Open the 90-day launch plan of a transformation
entry.chooseHealth: Open the health check of a transformation

launch.title: 90-day launch plan
launch.intro: The first 90 days of the transformation as dated tasks with owners, predecessors and required outputs.
launch.noPlanBody: Generate the plan from a start date: each window's actions and required outputs become tasks dated from that date.
launch.calendarDays: Day d of the plan is the start date plus d calendar days. A date on a non-working day is flagged, never moved.
launch.templateTitle: The three windows of the playbook
launch.templateIntro: The windows, objectives, actions and outputs the plan is generated from (B0133, B0134).
launch.redateHint: Every task not started moves by the same number of days; completed tasks keep their dates.
launch.noTasks: No task in this window matches the filter.
launch.addTaskIntro: A task of your own in one of the three windows.

day90.title: Day-90 leadership test
day90.intro: The six leadership questions at day 90, answered by the leaders with their evidence.
day90.noneBody: The test is created with the 90-day launch plan and scheduled on day 90. Generate the launch plan first.
day90.suggestionsNote: Suggested evidence is listed from the transformation's records where available. It is a link to confirm, never an answer.
day90.completeBody: All six questions need a response. A completed test is final.

health.title: Health check
health.intro: The 25-question Transformation Health Check: score out of 25, interpretation band and the top 3 actions, tracked over time.
health.historyIntro: Each reassessment is kept with the scoring scheme version it used.
health.noneBody: Start the first assessment of this transformation.
health.noScore: No score until every question is answered
health.noBand: No band until every question is answered
health.scoringAssumption: Scoring method: each Yes counts 1 and each No counts 0, out of 25. This is an implementation assumption; the playbook gives the checklist and "Score: __ / 25" without a scoring method.
health.incompleteNote: While any question is unanswered, the assessment is incomplete: it has no score and no band.
health.questionsIntro: The questions of the playbook, verbatim (B0150).
health.actionsIntro: Three ranked actions are required to submit the assessment.
health.submitBody: All 25 questions and the top 3 actions are needed. A submitted assessment keeps its scheme, score and band.

schemes.title: Health check scoring schemes
schemes.intro: The published versions of the health check scoring scheme, with their responses, credit and bands.
schemes.rule: A new scheme is a new version, drafted and published in the Playbook Studio. Partial credit or N/A needs its own interpretation bands: the four source bands are never reused. Existing assessments keep the version they used.
schemes.newVersion: Draft a new scheme version in the Playbook Studio

basisKind.points: Points out of the question count

restatement.title: KPI restatement
restatement.prospective: An approved KPI change applies from the next open period by default; closed periods keep their values and RAG. A closed period changes only through an approved restatement.
restatement.noneBody: This KPI's closed periods have never been restated.
restatement.createIntro: Choose the approved KPI version to apply, the closed periods to restate (at most 24) and the reason.
restatement.noClosedPeriods: No closed period of this KPI's frequency.
restatement.periodsHint: Only closed periods can be restated; an open period takes the new version from now on.
restatement.authorityValue: A holder of the restatement approval right in this transformation, never the requester
restatement.retained: Retained at submission: these rows are stored and do not change.
restatement.previewOnly: Preview of the draft: recalculated on each read and retained only when the restatement is submitted.
restatement.noRows: None of the selected periods has a value to restate.
restatement.noDifference: No difference: a side has no value
restatement.submitIntro: Submitting retains the reconciliation above and asks the holders of the approval right to decide.
restatement.awaiting: Awaiting the decision of a holder of the restatement approval right.
restatement.decideNote: Approving recalculates the selected periods once and offers every affected issued report for reissue as a new version. Issued reports themselves never change.
restatement.offersIntro: Each issued report affected by this restatement keeps its content; reissue it to create a new version.

preview.title: Formula preview
preview.nothingStored: A preview evaluates the formula with its example inputs and edge cases. It stores nothing.
preview.noVersion: This formula has no version to preview yet.
preview.edgeCasesIntro: Each input set to zero, left missing or made negative.

finance.title: Financial metrics
finance.intro: Optional NPV, ROI and payback for the business cases, with their assumptions.
finance.extensionBody: NPV, ROI and payback are not prescribed by the playbook. They are off by default and always show their assumptions.
finance.discountRateHint: A decimal fraction from 0 to 1 per period: 0.10 = 10 %. Leave empty for no discount rate (then NPV is not shown).
finance.disabledBody: The extension is off: no metric is shown.
finance.noCases: No business case in this transformation
finance.cashFlowsIntro: One row per period index from 0, in the business case currency ({{currency}}).
